system.description:
Effect: Cures any disease of level 6 or lower that is currently in your system. Against diseases of level 7 and higher affecting you, make a new defense roll (with two assets) against the disease; success means you overcome it. Until you use a one-hour or longer recovery, you are immune to diseases of level 6 and lower, and you get two assets against diseases of level 7 and higher.

Genre Items: amulet of fortitude (fantasy); immune system stimulant (sci-fi)
